[SWS_DM_00856] Initial values for Diagnostic Conversation
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04166
⌈
For a newly established Diagnostic Conversation, the
Diagnostic Server in-
stance
shall use the following initial values:
• Session set to Default Session (
kDefaultSession
),
• Security Level set to status Locked (
kLocked
),
• ActivityStatus to active
kActive
and
• ConversationIdentifier matching the value of
apext::diag::uds_trans-
port::UdsTransportProtocolMgr::IndicateMessage
call.
⌋
